comment: SoundSample's cook recipe (tools/soundcook recipe; docs/kiln/modding/sounds.md). Sources: ../audio/** (synthetic test tones made by tools/soundcook/samples/tones.py, one frequency per cue). Only the override step reads the installed client (its vanilla cue's other fields). Outputs: cooked/ (never committed).

dialog_confirm.comment: the Ui cue that plays sfx_ui_dialog_confirm (0050c296-…) when a dialogue option is confirmed

steps.name: ui_chime
steps.comment: 0.5 s 997 Hz: inline, 16-bit 48 kHz passes through exactly

steps.name: stereo_tone
steps.comment: 4 s, 440 Hz left / 660 Hz right; FLAC at 44.1 kHz: resampled, streamed

steps.name: blip_3d
steps.comment: the 3D sound: three takes, picked at random, never the same twice in a row

steps.name: hum_loop
steps.comment: 2 s of 220 Hz, whole cycles: a seamless positional loop (an engine hum, a campfire)

steps.name: ambience_loop
steps.comment: the looped ambience: 8 s stereo 330/331 Hz with a slow swell, 2D, played on the Ambience scene

steps.name: music_track
steps.comment: 12 s C major arpeggio on the Music bus

steps.name: confirm_tone
steps.comment: 0.4 s 1661 Hz: the replacement take of the vanilla cue below

steps.name: dialog_confirm
steps.comment: override of a vanilla cue: its other fields (Ui scene, volume 0.375, limits) are copied from the player's game

steps.name: greeting
steps.comment: a dialogue line: en two 523 Hz beeps, de three 784 Hz beeps; fr/es/zh players hear the English take

steps.name: narration_intro

subtitles.en: Long ago, the Flame burned bright over Embervale.

steps.comment: narration (no speaker): durations are written for the lore queue; English only, other voice languages stay silent (fallback null overrides the mod-wide en)
